claims.claim: Distinct events receive independent eligibility checks despite older SUBMITTED or AMBIGUOUS events and legacy flight. Focused regressions cover these cases; implementation-local synthetic sanity observed distinct-event progress.
Permanent SUBMITTED, RESOLVED_NOOP and tombstone dedupe remains intact. AMBIGUOUS events retain exact-proof or canonical-resolution reconciliation without blind resend.

Valid legacy flight pointers normalize idempotently to null while preserving event records, tombstones, binding generations and ambiguity holds. Regression fixtures include the supplied RUN-293 stale-flight shape.
An invocation-local flag prevents additional send attempts after one possible-click boundary. Later invocations can attempt distinct events without persisted lane flight.

Focused regressions retain exact target/binding safety, canonical NOOP, permanent dedupe, application acceptance/proof, state integrity and event-local failure handling, including fresh browser checks after legacy flight.

The commit changes only the four permitted files. No H4C semantics, TASK-293 artifacts, lifecycle authority, generic router/queue or roadmap changes were introduced; no live wake or operational-state reset was performed.

Both documents define TEMPORARY_WAKE_FIRST_CUTOVER_V2, record explicit Human wake-first risk acceptance, retire cross-event LANE_IN_FLIGHT eligibility, preserve exact-event and destination protections, and direct rollback through the global enable gate.
